sentences.english: It is Monday morning.
Ana came back from Tegucigalpa.

sentences.text: Sam habla con ella en la casa.
sentences.english: Sam talks with her at the house.

sentences.speaker: S
sentences.english: Ana, how was your trip?

sentences.speaker: A
sentences.english: Very good.

sentences.speaker: A
sentences.english: It was a good visit.

sentences.speaker: S
sentences.english: Did you leave on Saturday?

sentences.speaker: A
sentences.text: Sí, salí a las seis y subí al autobús.
sentences.english: Yes, I left at six and got on the bus.

sentences.speaker: A
sentences.english: I took my bag and bread.

sentences.speaker: A
sentences.text: Llegué a Tegucigalpa a las diez.
sentences.english: I arrived in Tegucigalpa at ten.

sentences.speaker: A
sentences.english: I got off at the terminal.

sentences.text: Karla esperó a Ana en la terminal.
sentences.english: Karla waited for Ana at the terminal.
Karla is Ana's friend.

sentences.speaker: K
sentences.english: Hi, Ana.

sentences.speaker: K
sentences.english: How was the trip?

sentences.speaker: A
sentences.text: Bien, pero sentí frío en el autobús.
sentences.english: Fine, but I felt cold on the bus.

sentences.speaker: K
sentences.text: Mirá, te traje café y pan.
sentences.english: Look, I brought you coffee and bread.
Ana drank the coffee.

sentences.text: Luego Karla y Ana siguieron por la calle hasta el centro.
sentences.english: Then Karla and Ana went on along the street to the downtown.

sentences.text: En el centro hay mucha gente.
sentences.english: In the downtown there are many people.

sentences.text: Ana vio una iglesia grande y un parque pequeño.
sentences.english: Ana saw a big church and a small park.
Ana got to know the new park.

sentences.text: Allí hay un lugar para comer.
sentences.english: There is a place to eat there.
Karla and Ana ordered food.

sentences.text: Ana pidió una baleada y Karla pidió sopa.
sentences.english: Ana ordered a baleada and Karla ordered soup.

sentences.speaker: K
sentences.english: Do you like the place?

sentences.speaker: A
sentences.english: Yes, I like it a lot.

sentences.speaker: K
sentences.text: Entre la iglesia y el parque hay otro lugar bueno, pero está lejos.
sentences.english: Between the church and the park there is another good place, but it is far.

sentences.speaker: A
sentences.english: I do not have time today.

sentences.speaker: A
sentences.english: We will go on tomorrow.

sentences.text: Karla vive cerca del centro, en una casa pequeña.
sentences.english: Karla lives near the downtown, in a small house.
Karla brought bread for dinner.

sentences.text: Karla puso la bolsa de Ana en su cuarto.
sentences.english: Karla put Ana's bag in her room.

sentences.text: Ana puso el celular en la mesa.
sentences.english: Ana put the cell phone on the table.

sentences.text: Karla puso café en la mesa.
sentences.english: Karla put coffee on the table.

sentences.text: El domingo Ana fue a la iglesia con Karla.
sentences.english: On Sunday Ana went to church with Karla.
Karla is a Christian.

sentences.text: Ella cree en Dios y ama a todos.
sentences.english: She believes in God and loves everyone.

sentences.text: Entre la gente de la iglesia hay mucha paz.
sentences.english: Among the people at church there is a lot of peace.

sentences.text: Allí Ana conoció a la familia de Karla.
sentences.english: There Ana met Karla's family.
They are called Sofía and Mario.

sentences.text: Fue una visita grande, con mucha comida.
sentences.english: It was a big visit, with a lot of food.

sentences.speaker: K
sentences.english: Mom, dad, this is Ana.

sentences.speaker: K
sentences.english: She is a nurse.

sentences.speaker: Z
sentences.english: Hello, Ana.

sentences.speaker: Z
sentences.english: Eat some chicken and drink some coffee.

sentences.speaker: A
sentences.english: Thank you, doña Sofía.

sentences.speaker: A
sentences.english: The food is very good.

sentences.speaker: Y
sentences.english: Karla talks about you a lot.

sentences.speaker: A
sentences.text: Yo también hablo mucho de Karla.
sentences.english: I talk about Karla a lot too.
Ana also met the pastor.

sentences.text: El pastor dijo: "Dios da paz a todos."
sentences.english: The pastor said: "God gives peace to everyone."

sentences.text: Allí Ana sintió paz en el corazón.
sentences.english: There Ana felt peace in her heart.
She felt very happy.

sentences.text: Entre amigos, el corazón está feliz.
sentences.english: Among friends, the heart is happy.

sentences.text: Ana siguió con Karla hasta la noche.
sentences.english: Ana stayed with Karla until night.

sentences.speaker: S
sentences.english: Was it sunny?

sentences.speaker: A
sentences.text: Sí, hizo sol y hizo calor.
sentences.english: Yes, it was sunny and hot.

sentences.speaker: A
sentences.english: But at night it rained.

sentences.speaker: S
sentences.english: Did you eat well?

sentences.speaker: A
sentences.text: Sí, comimos pollo, frijoles y tortilla.
sentences.english: Yes, we ate chicken, beans and tortilla.

sentences.speaker: A
sentences.english: I liked it a lot.

sentences.speaker: S
sentences.english: How much did you pay?

sentences.speaker: A
sentences.english: Nothing.

sentences.speaker: A
sentences.text: La familia de Karla pagó todo.
sentences.english: Karla's family paid for everything.

sentences.speaker: S
sentences.english: Is it summer in Tegucigalpa?

sentences.speaker: A
sentences.text: No, es el mes de la lluvia.
sentences.english: No, it is the month of the rain.

sentences.speaker: S
sentences.english: What did you learn?

sentences.speaker: A
sentences.text: Aprendí que Karla tiene una vida nueva en la ciudad.
sentences.english: I learned that Karla has a new life in the city.

sentences.speaker: A
sentences.text: Su familia vive en un pueblo pequeño.
sentences.english: Her family lives in a small village.

sentences.speaker: A
sentences.text: En Tegucigalpa no hay mar y no hay playa.
sentences.english: In Tegucigalpa there is no sea and no beach.

sentences.speaker: S
sentences.text: ¿Karla vino con vos a la terminal?
sentences.english: Did Karla come with you to the terminal?

sentences.speaker: A
sentences.english: No, she could not come.

sentences.speaker: A
sentences.english: She had to work.

sentences.speaker: A
sentences.text: Pero me dio pan para la familia.
sentences.english: But she gave me bread for the family.

sentences.speaker: A
sentences.text: Volví el domingo en la noche.
sentences.english: I came back on Sunday night.

sentences.speaker: A
sentences.english: I want to make another visit.

sentences.speaker: S
sentences.english: How nice, Ana.

sentences.speaker: S
sentences.english: Did you bring the cell phone?

sentences.speaker: A
sentences.english: Yes, here it is.

sentences.speaker: A
sentences.english: I have a lot to tell.
Sam is happy for Ana.

sentences.text: Ana toma su café y habla un poco más.
sentences.english: Ana drinks her coffee and talks a little more.

sentences.text: Es lunes, y hay mucho trabajo en la clínica.
sentences.english: It is Monday, and there is a lot of work at the clinic.
Ana has to go now.
